item.title: Another Asian American admissions fight reaches the Supreme Court
item.description: The Yappie · Following its rejection of affirmative action, the justices will hear a case alleging racial discrimination against Asian American middle school students in Maryland.

item.title: Supreme Court to Review Challenge to Admissions Policy That Increases Equal Opportunity for Middle School Students
item.description: Asian Americans Advancing Justice · The Supreme Court agrees to hear middle school admissions case in Montgomery County, Maryland.
